meta.title: Gavin's Lab — A one-person company, as a product
meta.description: Gavin's Lab: a real, running one-person company (OPC). 8 independent AI profiles collaborate over a kanban board; the human decides only people/money/stuff. Its value: five structural edges — organization, management, process, capability, agentic.

hero.h1c: — the company itself is the product
hero.p: This is not a project list. Gavin's Lab is a real, running one-person company — 8 independent AI profiles collaborate through a single kanban board; the human only decides on people/money/stuff, everything else runs on AI. How this company operates is the product we're building.

team.title: A team of AIs, each with a role
team.sub: Eight AI members, each with a role, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria. The human (Gavin) only handles people/money/stuff; the CEO decides everything else.

m1.name: Zhuangzi
m1.duty: Breaks goals into tasks, assigns work, calls the shots — he owns the profit.

m2.name: Mason
m2.duty: Writes code, fixes bugs, ships releases — he built every product here.

m3.name: Anchor
m3.duty: Monitors, health-checks, backs up — uptime is her craft, not luck.

m4.name: Echo
m4.duty: Writes and ships our story on four channels; data flows back into decisions.

m5.name: Amber
m5.duty: Replies same-day, escalates paid intent to Gavin, never over-promises.

m6.name: Penny
m6.duty: Books, ledgers, monthlies — cash first, so every number must be exact.

m7.name: Owl
m7.duty: Tracks rivals and markets; the CEO gets 1-3 actionable insights a month.

m8.name: Ada
m8.duty: Checks vs specs, guards regressions, re-tests fixes — questioning is the job.

mech.title: How the company runs
mech.sub: No KPI overload — just one decision hierarchy and one kanban board.
mech.dec1k: People / money / stuff (HR, finance, assets, legal)
mech.flow1b: — the CEO turns goals into task cards with acceptance criteria
mech.flow2b: — assignee is an independent profile, created and dispatched instantly
mech.flow3b: — each member works alone, logs and archives on completion
mech.flow4b: — state.json + kanban board, visible to everyone in real time

edge.title: Why this works
edge.sub: A company's value isn't how much it earns, but the structural advantages it builds.
edge.a1p: Eight AIs each with a clear role — no communication overhead, no office politics. A one-person company that still runs full functions.
edge.a2p: A single decision hierarchy — Gavin owns people/money/stuff, CEO Zhuangzi owns operations. Minimum layers, fastest decisions.
edge.a3p: Kanban dispatch + independent execution + dual-source-of-truth records. Every task has an assignee, acceptance criteria, and auto-archive on completion.
edge.a4p: CEO / dev / ops / marketing / support / finance / intel / QA — eight functions fully covered by AI. Full-time capability at near-zero marginal cost.
edge.a5p: 8 independent AI profiles + one shared kanban: division of labor without busywork, transparent and auditable, archived on completion. This organizational form can be replicated wholesale — humans only decide and set direction; agents run the rest by themselves.

works.title: What this system has already shipped
works.sub: Not demos — three products this company actually maintains.
works.mrdDesc: Zero API keys, the whole global market on one screen — A-shares / HK / US stocks, gold, commodities, US Treasuries, sector flows, supply chains. Open source, free self-hosting, Pro managed hosting with zero ops.
works.launcherDesc: A Zune/Metro retro-style Android launcher, ultra lightweight, with a hidden "earn merit" easter egg. A viral funnel piece that brings passers-by to Gavin's Lab.
works.opcDesc: How the company runs is the product: 8 AI profiles collaborating over kanban, a live activity feed, decision hierarchy — the page is driven by real status.json data. Click in, and you see a real company in operation.
